resourceName: Restoration in the Manduvirá region of Paraguay
description: Restoration in the Manduvirá region of Paraguay (here in after ARR Manduvirá) is a grouped project within the Afforestation, Reforestation and Revegetation (ARR) category whose aim is to certify forest plantations in western Paraguay. In its first instance, the project area consisted of 2,053.24 ha (179.73 ha planted) established between 2019 and 2021 and 1,000 ha are expected to be planted in 2023. In addition, the projects plan to plant 700 ha per year in the next years. The current instance is located in the departments of San Pedro (Juan de Mena), Cordilleras (Villa del Rosario) and Paraguarí  (Paraguarí), which are part of a region characterized by its farming economic activities, mainly extensive livestock for meat production. Before the start of the project, most of the project area was dedicated to this activity, whose management resulted in high soil degradation.
